name: Getting Your Remodel Painting Timeline Just Right

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Timing is everything when it comes to remodel painting, and getting the sequence right can save you a lot of headaches and potential damage. Here’s a breakdown of the ideal timeline for your remodel painting project:

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Painting should always come *after* all the heavy-duty construction and drywall installation or major repairs are done. This means the framing, plumbing, electrical rough-ins, and any new drywall should be fully installed, taped, and mudded. You don't want dust, debris, or accidental bumps from other trades to ruin your fresh paint.

step.name: Step 5
step.text: Once the drywall is complete and any repairs are made, it’s time for thorough surface preparation. This includes sanding, cleaning, and any necessary priming. Priming is especially important for new drywall or if you're making a big color change. Our team at HH Remodeling LLC makes sure this crucial step isn't rushed.

step.name: Step 7
step.text: This is where the magic happens! Once surfaces are prepped and primed, the actual painting can begin. This typically involves multiple coats to achieve the desired depth and durability. We ensure proper drying time between coats for a flawless finish.

step.name: Step 9
step.text: Ideally, painting is completed *before* new flooring is installed and before light fixtures, cabinets, and other permanent fixtures are put in. This allows for easier access to all wall and ceiling surfaces, prevents accidental drips or damage to new installations, and ensures a cleaner finish around these elements. Imagine trying to paint perfectly around a brand-new, expensive chandelier!

step.name: Step 11
step.text: After the paint has fully cured, it’s time for any final touch-ups and a thorough walkthrough to ensure everything meets your expectations. This is the moment to address any minor imperfections.

step.name: Step 12
step.text: Following this timeline helps protect your investment in new finishes and ensures a smooth, efficient remodel. If you're coordinating multiple trades, it's a huge benefit to have an experienced general contractor like Abraham Becerra and HH Remodeling LLC overseeing the entire process.
